title: fuzz_http input
description: Input schema for the fuzz_http tool (RFC-001 N8 typed HTTP fuzzer).

flow_id.description: Recorded HTTP stream id; when set, omitted base fields are inherited.

method.description: HTTP method base; required when flow_id is empty.

scheme.description: URL scheme; required when flow_id is empty.

authority.description: Host / :authority; required when flow_id is empty.

path.description: Request path; required when flow_id is empty.

headers.description: Ordered base header list; positions can target headers[N].value / .name. headers[N] indexes the input array — the Host header auto-injected from `authority` when this list omits it is NOT addressable via headers[N]; fuzz Host via the `authority` path.

body_set.description: Set true to override body to empty; otherwise omitting body inherits the original.

body_patches.description: Body patches applied to base body before positions.

override_host.description: Redirect dial target while preserving the request's Host/:authority.

tag.description: Tag stored on every variant Stream's Tags map.

positions.description: Ordered position list. The cartesian product yields the variant sequence (capped at 1000).

payloads.description: Payload values to substitute at this path.

encoding.description: Applies to every payload; default text.

stop_on_5xx.description: When true, abort the remaining variants once any variant returns a 5xx response.
